meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让输出适配ADHD读者，突出行动项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI回复更清晰易读，尤其是注意力不易集中时。
copy.tagline_en: Tailor output for ADHD readers: highlight next actions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI responses that are easier to follow, especially when you have attention difficulties.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 ADHD 友好的方式回答：先给可执行的下一步行动，多步骤任务编号，每轮重述进度，避免离题和客套，给出具体时间估计，出错时直接说原因和修法。
howto.when: 当你输入 "/i-have-adhd" 时启动，之后对所有消息持续生效，直到你说 "stop adhd mode" 才关闭。

say.text: 开启 ADHD 模式，回答时先给下一步行动，步骤编号，给出时间估计。
say.note: Claude 会按 ADHD 友好的格式组织回复。

say.text: 把这段解释改得更适合 ADHD 读者：开头给结论，列编号步骤，去掉离题内容。
say.note: Claude 会重写，突出行动和简洁。
结束该技能，恢复普通回复。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude replies ADHD-friendly: leads with a concrete next action, numbers steps, restates progress each turn, avoids tangents and small talk, gives specific time estimates, and states errors directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered by typing "/i-have-adhd"; stays active for all messages until you say "stop adhd mode".

say_en.text: Turn on ADHD mode: start with the next action, number steps, give time estimates.
Rewrite this for ADHD readers: conclusion first, numbered steps, no tangents.
